chapter: Second interview: bass, Parker and Miles
title: Lester Young's music and pre-Army tapes
summary: Sad music; Dexter Gordon's early tapes show Young swinging hard before the Army beating.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Dexter Gordon turned me on to something about Lester. Before Lester was in the Army, Dexter got ahold of all his tapes. If you get a chance, and you want to know about it, tell Dex you want to hear his tapes. He got tapes of Lester Young before the sergeants beat him up for finding a white woman's picture in his pocket.
Oh, yeah, I heard about that.
And he was swinging harder than Dexter.
He was swinging hard like Dexter.
And Dexter points this out to you. This is the way he played after they beat him up. Tore his spirit up. It was a sad kind of a song. I liked it more. But I like sad songs. I like crying.
I don't know, but I cry.
Yeah. Yeah, listen, I'll cry at a soap
